evidence.reason: The finding alleges that a branch with no `.cq/review/<branch>` folder makes `readdir` reject with ENOENT and surfaces a raw error instead of the 'no findings record; run review.run or pass --record' guidance. At the pinned tip this path is already hardened: `readdir(folder)` is wrapped in try/catch, non-ENOENT errors rethrow, and ENOENT sets `names = []` so `!files[0]` reaches the intended `finish('needs-human', 'no findings record; run review.run or pass --record')`. A dedicated comment documents that a branch with no `review.run` has no folder and that this is guidance, not a raw ENOENT — exactly the behavior the finding requests. The code defect no longer exists at the tip.
